if: the supply is a supply of vouchers by a supplier
then: the time of supply is the date of ISSUE of the voucher if the supply is identifiable at that point, and otherwise the date of REDEMPTION of the voucher
note: s.13(4) is worded identically to s.12(4). Recorded separately because Engine 3 must cite the sub-section that actually governs the supply it is looking at, not the one that happens to read the same.

evidence.quote: In case of supply of vouchers by a supplier, the time of supply shall be
the date of issue of voucher, if the supply is identifiable at that point
the date of redemption of voucher, in all other cases.
